cayley_status.available: 13 Cayley volume-level source-checked readers are front-facing. Volume I has complete source-label coverage (pages 1-573), and Volume VIII now has promoted source-checked repairs through pages 67-216, 317-441, tail repairs 517-570, plus native TikZ restoration of explicit diagram placeholders in pages 001-016, 217-266, and 517-528; the current Cayley top-level reader surface totals 5593 rendered pages.
cayley_status.broad_volume_drafts: Full per-volume working drafts are preserved in the artifact ZIP, but are not promoted as clean top-level readers.
cayley_status.chunk_level_note: The artifact/source layer preserves the older broad source trees plus repaired slice sources. The current count includes the six Volume I gap-fill PDFs added on 2026-06-02; broad per-volume drafts remain continuation material, not certification.
cayley_status.reason_for_replacement: Earlier broad Cayley drafts remain useful for continuation but are not as reliable as the promoted repaired slices.
cayley_status.volume_i_update_2026_06_02: Filled previous Volume I missing ranges 1-12, 38-50, 251-262, 389-400, 438-450, and 501-525; rebuilt the public Volume I reader from source-checked TeX/PDF slices only.
cayley_status.volume_viii_update_2026_06_02: Replaced defective or unsafe public Volume VIII slices for pages 067-216 and 317-416 with native source-checked TeX/PDF rebuilds, repaired explicit diagram placeholders in pages 001-016, 217-266, and 517-528 with native TikZ while preserving the fuller public prose/math bodies, promoted a full pages 417-441 source-checked rebuild, and rebuilt the Volume VIII reader to 541 selectable-text pages with zero embedded images. Active rebuild for pages 442-466 is still pending before any full-volume clean claim.
